disclosures.field: canonical URLs, robots directives, sitemap entries, and security.txt fields
disclosures.purpose: Give browsers, search engines, and security researchers the minimum authoritative routing metadata.
disclosures.exposure: Public and intentionally cacheable according to the route contract.
disclosures.retention: Retained while the corresponding public route or security contact remains active.

disclosures.field: framework-generated Next.js build identifiers and asset hashes
disclosures.purpose: Bind generated HTML to immutable framework assets and support cache-safe deployment routing.
disclosures.exposure: Public opaque identifiers; never include repository paths, account names, secrets, or commit messages.
disclosures.retention: Retained only for the lifetime of the deployment and its rollback window.

disclosures.field: public Supabase project endpoint and publishable client configuration
disclosures.purpose: Route public and authenticated browser requests to the intended shared backend.
disclosures.exposure: Public configuration only; service-role credentials and provider secrets are prohibited.
disclosures.retention: Retained while the production project remains the authoritative shared backend.

disclosures.purpose: Permit only the reviewed integrations and media delivery paths required by active features.
disclosures.exposure: Public hostnames without credentials, tokens, signed URLs, or private infrastructure identifiers.
disclosures.retention: Removed when the owning integration is retired or its origin changes through review.

disclosures.field: official guild profile URLs, provider labels, local marks, and Organization sameAs values
disclosures.purpose: Let visitors distinguish and intentionally open the reviewed official guild profiles.
disclosures.exposure: Public exact destinations and approved local branding assets; no widgets, embeds, tracking queries, or preconnects.
disclosures.retention: Retained only while each profile remains verified and organization-owned.

disclosures.field: approved sign-in provider labels and official local assets
disclosures.purpose: Identify each explicitly approved authentication choice using the provider's required presentation.
disclosures.exposure: Public labels and reviewed local assets only; client identifiers, secrets, and provider tokens are prohibited.
disclosures.retention: Retained only while the provider is source-approved; disabled providers remain unavailable at runtime.

disclosures.field: reviewed public event keys and Discord scheduled-event identifiers
disclosures.purpose: Keep the public Website schedule deterministic and reconcile duplicate or replaced guild events.
disclosures.exposure: Public opaque event identifiers only; guild tokens, private channels, and member data are prohibited.
disclosures.retention: Historical identifiers remain only where required for deterministic reconciliation and duplicate suppression.

disclosures.field: event publication template keys, asset paths, content hashes, and schedule contract version
disclosures.purpose: Bind reusable reviewed event content and derivatives to the server-authoritative publication schedule.
disclosures.exposure: Public immutable keys and asset paths; provider account identifiers, tokens, and unpublished mutation state are prohibited.
disclosures.retention: Retained with the reviewed reusable content version and its audit history.

disclosures.field: Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights browser telemetry
disclosures.purpose: Measure aggregate route reliability and performance without loading telemetry on isolated private raffle or spinner surfaces.
disclosures.exposure: Provider-defined minimal browser telemetry; no Mōchirīī provider secrets or private route content.
disclosures.retention: Controlled by the current Vercel plan and removed when the observability integration is disabled.

disclosures.field: upstream Social source attribution and corresponding-source notice
disclosures.purpose: Preserve the applicable upstream license and corresponding-source obligations in the dedicated legal location.
disclosures.exposure: Public only on the dedicated notice; ordinary Mōchirīī Social product surfaces remain Mōchirīī branded.
disclosures.retention: Retained for every distributed or network-served derivative release requiring the notice.

disclosures.field: accessible names, alternative text, roles, and state descriptions
disclosures.purpose: Expose equivalent meaning, state, and operation to assistive technologies.
disclosures.exposure: Public rendered accessibility text with the same disclosure limits as visible copy.
disclosures.retention: Retained with the user-facing control or content that it describes.
